text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal gets the weather→BBC→mail procedure and the subject and body templates right, but it has four problems: it ends with Send even though the user clicked Discard, it skips opening the first BBC result, it uses day_of_week where the true workflow uses a date, and it splits the traveler into separate email and name parameters instead of building {traveler}@example.com; the steps are concrete enough to automate, but the final Send step is wrong and unsafe."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the weather→BBC→mail procedure and the subject and body templates right, but it has four problems: it ends with Send even though the user clicked Discard, it skips opening the first BBC result, it uses day_of_week where the true workflow uses a date, and it splits the traveler into separate email and name parameters instead of building {traveler}@example.com; the steps are concrete enough to automate, but the final Send step is wrong and unsafe.
